Card Q&A.q: If there are two copies of this card in my security stack, and both copies are activated in the same turn, do their effects stack?

Effect: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn.
Security Effect: [Security] All of your Digimon and Security Digimon get +5000 DP for the turn. Then add this card to its owner's hand.
